  ROUND(SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) FILTER (
    WHERE EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM customers c
      JOIN members m ON m.customer_unique_id = c.customer_unique_id
      JOIN user_tag_map utm ON utm.member_id = m.member_id
      JOIN user_tags ut ON ut.tag_id = utm.tag_id
      WHERE c.customer_id = o.customer_id
        AND ut.tag_code = 'NEW_USER'
    )
  ), 2) AS new_customer_gmv,
  ROUND(SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) FILTER (
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM customers c
      JOIN members m ON m.customer_unique_id = c.customer_unique_id
      JOIN user_tag_map utm ON utm.member_id = m.member_id
      JOIN user_tags ut ON ut.tag_id = utm.tag_id
      WHERE c.customer_id = o.customer_id
        AND ut.tag_code = 'NEW_USER'
    )
  ), 2) AS old_customer_gmv
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
LIMIT 100;
